text:
emma: Heads-up from onboarding today: our JS sampleapp hit a nasty mismatch when using the batching helper with the rerank embeddings. Expected 768d vectors, sometimes got 512d or an errored empty array after a retry.

rafael: do you have the call details? which SDK version + helper config?

emma: node sdk v0.9.1, batching helper default config (no explicit fallback_model). Call was simple:
```js
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/rerank-1', input: ['doc1','doc2'], batch_size: 2, retry: { max_attempts: 2 } })
```
Response varied. One successful call returned 768-d vectors. One retry returned 512-d and headers had x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-lite, x-retry-count: 1. Another retry returned an empty embeddings array and status 200.

priya: empty array + 200 is a bug. SDK should surface a non-2xx or at least error on empty body. Which sampleapp flow hit this?

emma: our retriever pipeline; it silently produced zero similarity scores and the bug surfaced only in prod smoke tests.

zoe: looks like two separate problems: 1) implicit fallback to a compact variant with different dim, and 2) helper normalizing empty bodies into empty embedding lists instead of bubbling error. Also sounds like SDK parity: other languages might behave differently.

rafael: agreed. Node batching helper had a recent change to add cost-tier fallbacks and the default was set to a compact variant. If the helper retries it can switch models. Python/Go helpers didn't pick that default key name, so parity gap explains why only JS sampleapp tripped.

priya: quick mitigation for customers: set retry: { fallback_model: null } to disable auto-fallback, or explicitly set retry: { fallback_model: 'rerank-1' } to keep the same model on retries. Also add a local assertion: if (!resp.embeddings || resp.embeddings.length === 0) throw.

emma: added a tiny preflight in the sampleapp that checks vector length and fails loudly. Example polyfill we pushed:
```js
const raw = await client.embeddings.create(cfg)
const embeddings = raw.embeddings || raw.vectors || []
const dim = raw.embedding_dim || raw.dim || (embeddings[0] && embeddings[0].length)
if (!embeddings.length) throw new Error('empty embeddings from API')
if (dim !== expectedDim) throw new Error(`unexpected embedding dim: ${dim}`)
```
zoe: good. We should also make the SDK expose model_variant from x-redwood-model-variant as response.model_variant so app code and logs can show it.

rafael: created DEVEX-4410 to: 1) remove implicit fallback default from node batching helper, 2) surface model_variant in SDK responses, 3) make the helper throw on empty embedding bodies, and 4) add the polyfill to sampleapp quickstart. PR #6020 incoming.

infra-bot: Deploy triggered: deploy/patch/6020 to staging  2481230300

priya: also file for SDK parity sweep: ensure keys are canonical across SDKs (embeddings vs vectors, embedding_dim vs dim) and ensure retry config key names are consistent. We'll add a small CI smoke to run sampleapps across SDKs.

emma: confirmed explicit fallback_model: null fixed our local repro, and the polyfill prevented silent failures. I'll submit a docs PR for the onboarding checklist: "assert embedding shape and log model_variant". Thanks folks :raised_hands:
